checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same candle jar and wax preserved on a pale kitchen counter
must.why: Jar and wax are preserved, but the setting is a white marble bathroom ledge, not a kitchen counter.

must.item: Original wooden shelf and plant absent
must.why: Neither the shelf nor the plant is visible.

must.item: Warm highlights consistent with light from upper left
must.why: The window is at the upper left and the jar is lit from that side.

must.item: Grounded shadow toward lower right, no contradictory original shadow
must.why: Only a very faint contact shadow is visible. It is not clearly directed to the lower right.

must.item: Glass edges show new setting without shelf or plant fragments
must.why: The glass is clean and shows the towel and marble tones, with no remnants.
The image is square and has no text.

faults.what: The scene is a bathroom with a towel and eucalyptus, not the pale kitchen counter the must-have expects. The user did not specify a location, so this is only a mismatch with the checklist.
The shadow under the jar is weak and does not read clearly as falling to the lower right.
The jar is slightly narrower and its proportions are slightly changed compared with the original.

summary: The candle was moved convincingly onto a bright marble bathroom ledge with natural lighting and clean glass, but it is not a kitchen counter and the shadow is weak.
